lessons.title: The Poem: The Cricket
lessons.notes_html:
About the Poem

The Cricket is a poem by Marjorie Barrows. It tells about a poet and a little bug.

What Happens in the Poem

  • When the rain had gone away and the sun was shining everywhere, the poet ran out on the walk to play.
  • The poet found a little bug. The bug was running fast, then it stopped for breath at last.
  • The bug was all black and shiny in the sun.
  • The bug chirped a song for the poet and gave his wings a little tug.
  • The bug showed that he was very glad to be a bug.

Key Facts

  • The poem 'The Cricket' is written by Marjorie Barrows.
  • The poet finds a bug while walking.
  • The little bug was glad to be a bug.
  • The little bug gave a little tug to its wings.

Digraphs: ch, sh, th

A digraph is two letters that make one sound. The digraphs in this unit are ch, sh and th.

  • Initial position: ch — chirp, chair; sh — shine, shop; th — three, that.
  • Final position: ch — rich, much; sh — wish, push; th — breath, cloth.

Reading the words: cheese begins with ch; much ends with ch; shark begins with sh; brush ends with sh; thin begins with th; with ends with th. More digraph words: chair, ship, think.

Rhyming Words

  • away = play
  • tug = bug
  • me = she
  • fast = last
  • where = there

Parts of the Body

lessons.title: Grammar: Nouns and Pronouns

Nouns — Naming Words

A noun is a naming word. It names a person, place, animal or thing.

  • People: teacher.
  • Places: school.
  • Animals: cat.
  • Things: book.

Naming words in the picture: sun, child, bird, tree, ball.

Pronouns

A pronoun is a word used in place of a noun: I, you, he, she, it, we, they.

  • She is a good girl.
  • He is a naughty boy.
  • They are playing.
  • We are happy.
  • It is a cute cat.
  • I like to eat vegetables.

Zain in the Garden

On a Sunday morning, Zain is in his grandfather's garden. His grandfather is sowing a seed and teaches him how to do it.

Five Steps to Sow a Seed

  1. Make a small pit in the soil.
  2. Sow a seed.
  3. Spread a little soil over it.
  4. Sprinkle some water on it.
  5. Water it regularly.

After a few weeks the seed grows into a young plant. The step after step 3 is step 4: Sprinkle some water on it.

Zain's Promise

Position Words

The Ant in Trouble

On a hot summer day, a thirsty ant looked for water. She reached a river, climbed a stone, slipped and fell in.

The Dove Saves the Ant

Next day a bird catcher came to trap the dove with his net. The ant bit him on the foot; he screamed in pain and dropped his net. The dove flew away and thanked the ant for saving her life.

lessons.title: Sounds, Comprehension and Vocabulary
lessons.notes_html:
Plural Sounds

  • /s/ — ants, books.
  • /z/ — birds, friends.
  • /iz/ — boxes, watches.

Gestures — What They Say

  • Hello! (hand raised)
  • Woo hoo! (arms up in joy)
  • Oh! (hand on head)

Key Facts from Units 10–12

  • The ant fell into the river because she climbed a stone to drink water, slipped and fell in.
  • To make a greeting card we need paper, scissors and markers.

Word Meanings

  • half = either of the two equal parts.
  • excited = showing happiness.
  • scream = to give a loud, high cry.
  • greet = welcome.
